home.description: aMarticeramics Lab is a ceramics studio and concept store at Piazza Malfatti 10 in Rovereto, Italy, with creative evening workshops for adults and children.
home.lead: Always wanted to shape or decorate ceramics? This is the place for you! Join my creative workshops.
home.quote: In a hectic world, here we slow down and get to know each other.

space.custom: I make custom ceramics, made in Italy.
space.labs: Ceramics, and more: guest makers and artists take turns in the room, with jewellery, macramé, candles, paper, astrology and Christmas decorations.
space.store: Next to the studio: aMarti's ceramics and work by local women makers and artists, for sale in the shop.
space.room: Birthdays, workshops, events and team building: message me and we'll talk.

home.contact: Information and bookings by DM on Instagram.
home.shopLead: aMarti's ceramics and work by local women makers are in the shop at Piazza Malfatti 10.

services.title: Services
services.lead: Besides the workshops in the programme, the aMarticeramics Lab room can be booked for parties, birthdays and tailor-made activities.
services.labs: Every month, ceramics workshops and workshops by guest makers and artists, for adults and children. Sign up from the workshop's page.
services.party: A birthday or a party in the studio, with a creative activity for children or adults. Message me the date and how many you are.
services.room: The room for workshops, events, team building and other activities. Tell me what you have in mind and we'll talk.
services.custom: I make custom ceramics, made in Italy: tell me your idea.

about.title: About
about.lead: I'm Martina, a ceramicist. In November 2025 I opened aMarticeramics Lab at Piazza Malfatti 10 in Rovereto: a ceramics studio and concept store, with creative workshops for all ages.

contact.lead: Fill in the form: we will reply as soon as we can.

contact.privacy: We use these details only to reply to you.
contact.fallback: If you don't see the confirmation, try again or write to us directly.

signup.title: Book your place
signup.lead: Leave your details: signing up is free and doesn't commit you to pay now.
signup.how: When the workshop reaches its minimum number of people, Martina confirms your place on WhatsApp or by email and sends you a SumUp link to pay. If the workshop doesn't go ahead, you pay nothing.
signup.phoneHint: Preferably a number with WhatsApp: the confirmation arrives there.
signup.noteHint: Allergies, special needs, if you're coming with someone…
signup.privacyAfter: and agree to my data being used to handle the sign-up.
signup.error: We couldn't record your sign-up. Check the fields (valid email and phone, privacy box ticked) and try again.
signup.orInstagram: Prefer to write? You can also book by DM on Instagram.
signup.fallback: If you don't see the confirmation, try again or message us on Instagram.
signup.suggestions: Optional: I'd like Martina to message me (WhatsApp or email) with suggestions for other workshops based on the ones I like. I can ask her to stop at any time.

signupThanks.title: You're on the list!
signupThanks.lead: We received your sign-up: thank you!
signupThanks.next: When the workshop reaches its minimum number of people, Martina confirms your place on WhatsApp or by email.
signupThanks.pay: Payment comes only after the confirmation, with a SumUp link: until then you don't need to do anything.
